meaning_to_preserve: Write a handoff note when delivering
State whether this version changes the problem, numerical values, or time
The person taking over should know which part to inspect first
author_proposal.author_reason: เขียนบอก retains the written handoff. ตัวเลข states the numerical values without the isolated ค่า/ค่ะ sound trap. คนรับงานต่อ explicitly names the successor, and ดูส่วนไหนก่อน keeps the first place to inspect.
author_proposal.remaining_uncertainty: Replacing ค่า with ตัวเลข is a wording hypothesis, not proof that a future voice and recognizer will produce the intended numeric-value phrase.
